extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia editors/contributors (especially new users trying to create an article)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and procedural requirements for creating a new Wikipedia article about a film (or similar topic), aimed at ensuring the title isn't a duplicate and the creator meets account requirements. Covers alternative submission routes, technical issues, and checks for deletion or redirects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a prerequisite for creating pages directly. If you are not autoconfirmed, use alternative submission methods (article wizard or draft review) or request a new article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or submit a draft/request new article
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot create a live article (e.g., not autoconfirmed or the topic may need review), follow the draft/submission workflows so experienced editors can review and publish the article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for existing articles (avoid duplicates)
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for "Tim Heidecker film" in existing articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, check whether the topic already exists under another title or as part of another article to avoid duplicating content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check for pages that link to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Searching for incoming links can reveal existing coverage or appropriate target pages; use that to decide whether to create a new page or a redirect/section.

rubrics_metrics.name: New-page visibility delay and purge troubleshooting
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you think a recently created page should exist but doesn't appear, allow time for propagation or manually purge the cache; do not immediately recreate duplicates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title case-sensitivity and use of redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify exact capitalization and variants; if the correct article exists under a different capitalization or spelling, create a redirect rather than a separate page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check deletion log if page was deleted
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review the deletion log to learn why a page was removed and whether recreation is appropriate; follow guidance in the linked help page to avoid repeating issues that caused deletion.
